mapper.sql: SELECT restaurant_id, ROUND(AVG(CAST(score AS DOUBLE)), 1) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews GROUP BY restaurant_id
SELECT winner_restaurant_id AS restaurant_id, COUNT(*) AS win_count FROM battles WHERE status = 'CLOSED' AND winner_restaurant_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner_restaurant_id
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id AS id, r.name AS name, r.category AS category, r.walk_minutes AS walkMinutes, r.price AS price, r.active AS active, COALESCE(rv.avg_score, 0) AS avgScore, COALESCE(rv.review_count, 0) AS reviewCount, COALESCE(w.win_count, 0) AS winCount FROM restaurants r LEFT JOIN () rv ON rv.restaurant_id = r.id LEFT JOIN () w ON w.restaurant_id = r.id
WHERE r.active = TRUE
ORDER BY r.id

SELECT b.winner_restaurant_id AS restaurantId, COUNT(*) AS winCount FROM battles b WHERE b.status = 'CLOSED' AND b.winner_restaurant_id IS NOT NULL AND b.battle_date >= #{from} GROUP BY b.winner_restaurant_id

SELECT b.id AS battleId, b.battle_date AS battleDate, w.name AS winnerName, COALESCE(c.cand_count, 0) AS candidateCount, COALESCE(v.vote_count, 0) AS voterCount FROM battles b LEFT JOIN restaurants w ON w.id = b.winner_restaurant_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT battle_id, COUNT(*) AS cand_count FROM candidates GROUP BY battle_id) c ON c.battle_id = b.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT battle_id, COUNT(*) AS vote_count FROM votes GROUP BY battle_id) v ON v.battle_id = b.id ORDER BY b.battle_date DESC

SELECT r.id AS restaurantId, r.name AS restaurantName, r.category AS category, COALESCE(w.win_count, 0) AS winCount, COALESCE(v.vote_count, 0) AS totalVotes, COALESCE(c.cand_count, 0) AS candidateCount, COALESCE(rv.avg_score, 0) AS avgScore, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.cand_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(w.win_count, 0) * 100.0 / c.cand_count, 1) END AS winRate FROM restaurants r LEFT JOIN () w ON w.restaurant_id = r.id LEFT JOIN () rv ON rv.restaurant_id = r.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT restaurant_id, COUNT(*) AS cand_count FROM candidates GROUP BY restaurant_id ) c ON c.restaurant_id = r.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ca.restaurant_id, COUNT(*) AS vote_count FROM votes vo JOIN candidates ca ON ca.id = vo.candidate_id GROUP BY ca.restaurant_id ) v ON v.restaurant_id = r.id -- 한 번도 후보로 오른 적 없는 식당은 순위를 매길 근거가 없다. -- 전부 0점으로 나열되면 순위표를 읽기 어렵다. WHERE COALESCE(c.cand_count, 0) > 0 ORDER BY winCount DESC, totalVotes DESC, avgScore DESC

SELECT m.department AS department, r.category AS category, COUNT(*) AS voteCount, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.department), 1) AS sharePercent FROM votes v JOIN members m ON m.id = v.member_id JOIN candidates c ON c.id = v.candidate_id JOIN restaurants r ON r.id = c.restaurant_id GROUP BY m.department, r.category ORDER BY m.department, voteCount DESC

SELECT DAY_OF_WEEK(b.battle_date) AS weekday, CASE DAY_OF_WEEK(b.battle_date) WHEN 1 THEN '일요일' WHEN 2 THEN '월요일' WHEN 3 THEN '화요일' WHEN 4 THEN '수요일' WHEN 5 THEN '목요일' WHEN 6 THEN '금요일' ELSE '토요일' END AS weekdayName, r.category AS category, COUNT(*) AS voteCount FROM votes v JOIN battles b ON b.id = v.battle_id JOIN candidates c ON c.id = v.candidate_id JOIN restaurants r ON r.id = c.restaurant_id GROUP BY DAY_OF_WEEK(b.battle_date), r.category ORDER BY weekday, voteCount DESC

SELECT t.member_id AS memberId, t.name AS memberName, t.department AS department, t.total_votes AS totalVotes, t.category AS topCategory, t.cat_votes AS topCategoryVotes, ROUND(t.cat_votes * 100.0 / t.total_votes, 1) AS pickyPercent FROM ( SELECT m.id AS member_id, m.name AS name, m.department AS department, r.category AS category, COUNT(*) AS cat_votes, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.id) AS total_votes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, r.category) AS rn FROM votes v JOIN members m ON m.id = v.member_id JOIN candidates c ON c.id = v.candidate_id JOIN restaurants r ON r.id = c.restaurant_id GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.department, r.category ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY pickyPercent DESC, totalVotes DESC

SELECT b.id AS battleId, b.battle_date AS battleDate, w.name AS winnerName, COALESCE(c.cand_count, 0) AS candidateCount, COALESCE(v.voter_count, 0) AS voterCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members) AS memberCount, ROUND(COALESCE(v.voter_count, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members), 0), 1) AS participationPercent FROM battles b LEFT JOIN restaurants w ON w.id = b.winner_restaurant_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT battle_id, COUNT(*) AS cand_count FROM candidates GROUP BY battle_id ) c ON c.battle_id = b.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT battle_id, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS voter_count FROM votes GROUP BY battle_id ) v ON v.battle_id = b.id ORDER BY b.battle_date DESC

SELECT r.category AS category, COALESCE(v.vote_count, 0) AS voteCount, COALESCE(w.win_count, 0) AS winCount, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(v.vote_count, 0) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes), 1) END AS sharePercent FROM (SELECT DISTINCT category FROM restaurants) r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT re.category, COUNT(*) AS vote_count FROM votes vo JOIN candidates ca ON ca.id = vo.candidate_id JOIN restaurants re ON re.id = ca.restaurant_id GROUP BY re.category ) v ON v.category = r.category LEFT JOIN ( SELECT re.category, COUNT(*) AS win_count FROM battles b JOIN restaurants re ON re.id = b.winner_restaurant_id WHERE b.status = 'CLOSED' GROUP BY re.category ) w ON w.category = r.category ORDER BY voteCount DESC, r.category
